Compliance and operations automation for banks and fintechs

Pick the area your team works in. Each page shows the procedures Verkflo can run there, what the agent handles and what stays with your reviewers.

By type of check

Customer and business due diligence, and the screening and alert work that follows.

  • +1↗ KYC automationOnboarding reviews, periodic reviews and PEP or adverse media checks for individual customers.
  • +1↗ KYB automationCompany checks, beneficial ownership mapping and owner screening for business customers and suppliers.
  • +1↗ AML automationSanctions hit review, transaction monitoring alert triage and fraud alert triage, on top of your existing tools.

By team

The same agents, grouped by the team that owns the procedures.

  • +1↗ Compliance operations automationThe daily casework of a financial crime team, run as reviewed agents from your written procedures.
  • +1↗ Banking operations automationCard disputes, credit limit reviews, credit file and loan checks, account closures and complaints.
  • +1↗ Fintech operations automationKYC and KYB at onboarding, disputes, complaints and vendor reviews for small operations teams.

    Runs record their version

    Each run records the exact version of the procedure it followed, and old versions stay readable.

    Reviews where your rules say

    A hash-chained audit log

    Each entry carries the hash of the one before it. Verifying the log recomputes the chain and flags entries that no longer match.
